model_name.description: Cloud Gemini model for public data only: compiling trial criteria, explanations, fictional patients. The evaluation in bench/RESULTS.md was measured with gemini-3.5-flash-lite.

fallback_model_name.description: Off (none) by default. A Gemini model name here is tried once, for at most 45 s, when model_name is still overloaded (HTTP 500/503) after three retries. Use it only if model_name is down while another model works.
